about_short_description.short_description: Quara Finance is a Saudi company that offers financial solutions, services, and products.

product.name: Personal Loan
product.description: Provides individuals with financing up to SAR 50,000 with flexible repayment terms up to 5 years, designed to meet various personal financial needs.

product.name: Purchase Financing
product.description: Enables customers to finance purchases at partner retail locations with flexible payment plans tailored to their budgets.

product.name: E-Purchase Financing
product.description: Offers installment-based financing for online shopping through trusted partners, with repayment terms up to 36 months.

product.name: SME Business Financing
product.description: Provides financing solutions tailored to small and medium enterprises to support business startup, expansion, and invoice pre-financing needs.
